_comment: Campaign islands for the scrollable island map. Each island is exactly 10 consecutive campaign levels (game/scripts/levels/island_model.gd). `hero`/`stages`/`map` are AssetLibrary ids for the user-supplied art (game/assets/islands/): hero = full scene + name banner, stages = 5x2 sheet of the 10 stage dioramas (sliced with AtlasTexture, source PNG never modified), map = the assembled island map used as the section background. `theme` is the env id used as the in-level backdrop for that island's levels. `stage_regions` (optional, normalized x,y,w,h of the stages sheet) overrides the default uniform 5x2 grid slice — only island 2 needs it (its sheet has the logo in the top-left and an uneven 4+6 layout). `node_positions` (optional, normalized to the section) overrides the procedural serpentine trail. Unlock rules are NOT set here — they come from the existing sequential ProgressService rule (an island opens when the previous island's last level is cleared).
